    The Euler form of a critical piece is not weakly positive #

    A critical piece (a representation-infinite convex piece whose smaller convex pieces are representation-finite) is connected (connected_of_critical), so it has indecomposables of every size (unbounded_of_not_pieceRepFin) and so does its preprojective component (PreprojComp.unbounded). Hence its Euler form is not weakly positive (not_weaklyPositive_critical; the representation-theoretic half of Bongartz's criterion).
